breakdown.description: Preamble states two incompatible interpretations of Nx and dx (interval-based vs point-based).
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt contained a preamble with two conflicting definitions for the spatial grid (one for periodic domains, and one for closed intervals). The agent correctly identified the correct definition for the specified periodic domain, which is `dx=1/Nx`, and omitted the contradictory instruction (`dx=(b-a)/(Nx-1)`). This matches the ground truth, which also removed the contradictory statement.
